prompt: Where do freshly machine-washed and just-rinsed bowls go?
promptZh: 剛用洗碗機洗好的碗和只沖過水的碗，分別該放哪裡？

options.text: Machine-washed bowls go in grey; rinsed bowls go in white.
options.zh: 機洗碗放灰架；沖過的碗放白架。
options.whyZh: 位置顛倒了。灰架收回收台的舊碗，白架只放已機洗的碗。

options.text: Both go in white once there are no visible crumbs.
options.zh: 兩種碗只要看不到碎屑，就都放白架。
options.whyZh: 沖掉碎屑不代表可以供餐，只有機洗碗進白架。

options.text: Machine-washed bowls go to the supply tent; rinsed ones go in grey.
options.zh: 機洗碗送去補給帳篷；沖過的碗放灰架。
options.whyZh: 沖過的放灰架沒錯，但帳篷是領取封裝備品的地方，不是機洗碗的存放處。

options.text: Machine-washed bowls go in white; rinsed ones go in grey.
options.zh: 機洗碗放白架；沖過的碗放灰架。
options.whyZh: 白架只放機洗碗；回收碗即使沖過也還不能供餐，應放灰架。

explanationZh: 白架只放機洗碗；回收碗即使沖過也還不能供餐，應放灰架。
evidence: Bowls from the return bench go into the grey rack, even if they look clean. | A quick rinse removes crumbs so the rack stays tidy; it doesn't make a bowl ready to serve. | Only bowls from the dishwasher go into the white rack.

vocabulary.note: 此處用來清洗盛餐用碗。
